items.title: US envoys meet Zelenskyy in Kyiv after Moscow; 'substantive plans' promised, no breakthrough
items.title_zh: 美特使莫斯科后再会泽连斯基：承诺“实质方案”但未见突破
items.summary_zh: Steve Witkoff与Jared Kushner结束克里姆林宫会晤后抵基辅；白宫称在莫斯科讨论了“未来几周将宣布的实质方案”，克宫称美方提出若干解决路径。泽连斯基与Witkoff均给予正面评价，但未宣布停战突破；泽连斯基暗示战争可能延续至冬季并寻求欧美支持。首都互不打击的临时安排仍在，其他城市交火未停——乌方称俄一夜出动逾百架无人机/导弹。外交节奏与前线消耗并行。

quotes.author: Volodymyr Zelenskyy
quotes.en: We very much hope that we will be able to reach agreements with our American partners, and we are counting on the support of our European partners if the war continues in winter — and this is how it appears at the moment.
quotes.zh: 我们非常希望能与美国伙伴达成协议；如果战争延续到冬天——眼下看来就是如此——我们也指望欧洲伙伴的支持。

items.fetch_notes: NM列表估分6.5；与昨日普京会晤头条不同角度（基辅场）；据SBS/Al Jazeera

items.title: Music Theory for Programmers
items.title_zh: 给程序员的乐理：热帖遭遇科班“大多错了”
items.summary_zh: 《Music Theory for Programmers》约356赞；评论区有音乐学位与职业演奏背景的人直言：文中大多不是乐理，是乐理的部分也常错到误导。另有人链到“读者反叛”一文，暗示生成/简化知识的阅读疲劳。跨界科普的信任税被当场开票。

quotes.author: seanhunter
quotes.en: This is (mostly) not music theory and what is music theory is mostly wrong or incomplete to the point of being wildly misleading. Source: have degree and postgrad in music, was a professional musician until RSI put paid to that career, wife is a professional musician and teaches to postgrad level at 2 conservertoires, most of our friends are professional musicians, have a house full of scores and music books. If you actually want to learn music theory for the purposes of playing I strongly recommend you just follow whatever tutorials for your instrument and style and if you get to the point where feel you want to learn more and take it seriously in and of itself, buy “The Jazz Theory Book” by Mark Levine[1]. In spite of what it says, there really isn’t any such thing as Jazz theory - it’s just music theory, and this book is a great presentation with lots of good examples. If you like jazz (or the western popular music tradition including rock, pop, funk, etc) you’ll come out understanding how that music works better than most people. If you’re doing a music degree, there will be books recommended by your music programme, but honestly, Levine will cover most of what you need if you’
quotes.zh: 这（大多）不是乐理；是乐理的部分也大多错误或不完整，到了严重误导的程度。来源：音乐学位与研究生，做过职业演奏。

quotes.author: ergonaught
quotes.en: I want to read it, because it’s interesting. And yet. https://bcantrill.dtrace.org/2026/09/05/the-revolt-of-the-re...
quotes.zh: 我想读，因为有趣。然而——还是去看Cantrill那篇《读者的反叛》吧。

items.title: Justice Department backs OpenAI: training LLMs on copyrighted text is fair use
items.title_zh: 司法部挺OpenAI：用受版权文本训练大模型属合理使用
items.summary_zh: 特朗普政府9月1日向纽约南区联邦法院提交利益声明，在《纽约时报》等诉OpenAI/微软案中主张：LLM训练对版权文本具有“高度转换性”、一般构成合理使用；若要求普遍许可将抬高门槛、巩固巨头并损害美国AI竞争力与国家安全。声明依28 U.S.C. §517，有说服力但无约束力。政府刻意切割训练与输出侵权，并批评Kadrey案把训练与输出混为一谈的分析。

quotes.author: U.S. Department of Justice brief
quotes.en: Constraining LLM development under a misunderstanding of fair use doctrine would thwart such creative and scientific progress while hindering American prosperity and economic mobility.
quotes.zh: 在对合理使用原则的误解下束缚大模型发展，将挫伤创造性与科学进步，并阻碍美国繁荣与经济流动性。

items.title: Doomscrolling Ourselves to Death
items.title_zh: 把我们自己刷到死：Doomscrolling的焦虑与诚实阅读
items.summary_zh: 长文讨论无尽信息流如何抬高焦虑与拖延（约355赞）。评论承认屏幕时间恶化拖延；另一条要求诚实：你真读完正文了吗，还是只看了前几段就在评论区doomscroll。元评论把文章主题演成了现场行为艺术。

quotes.author: Escapado
quotes.en: On a personal level I have become more anxious and it has become more difficult to deal with my tendency to procrastinate the more screen time I have and the more I am exposed to social media. I have in essence deleted the vast majority of my social media accounts years ago, but stayed a passive and rather anonymous consumer on Reddit, X and YouTube. A few weeks ago I blocked them too. I would say in totality I read more than I read growing up, but it was usually in the form of short content. Same goes for watching things. Unlimited access to short form content of any form has made my monkey brain feel a resistance to longer form content and that annoys and scares me. It’s like having free hyper palatable but unhealthy food in front of you at all times while you know that there are fresh ingredients for a proper healthy meal in the fridge. And as absurd as it sounds as a 30 something year old, I am now actively working on getting into the habit of reading books again and watching movies in one go to work on that specific problem. And talking ti my friends and family it looks like many of them struggle with similar problems. I am less worried about the classics or the depth of wisdo
quotes.zh: 就个人而言，屏幕时间越多、接触的刺激流越多，我越焦虑，也越难对付拖延倾向。

quotes.author: teiferer
quotes.en: Scrolling through the comments here, let's be honest about having actually read the entire article. Have you? Be honest. At first I had not, only the first 3-4 paragraphs. And it just read like another one of those articles where somebody is sad about their own and their kids' habits. I then found that most comments here are about that too. But I realized that not actually reading a lengthy article like this one is part of the problem, so I went back. I have read it fully now and noticed two things. First, it's a very lengthy way to say few things. The author could surely have made the point much more crisp. But second, it's not just about the personal situation and some abstract form of person in society. It's also about those "in charge". And that's frightening.
quotes.zh: 刷着这里的评论，咱们老实说有没有真读完整篇文章。一开始我没有，只读了前三四段。

items.title: PrevenTRON: Alzheimer's drug trontinemab trial targets symptom-free at-risk adults
items.title_zh: PrevenTRON试验：用trontinemab在无症状高风险成人中预防阿尔茨海默病
items.summary_zh: 罗氏III期PrevenTRON计划招募约1600名55–80岁认知未受损但血浆p-tau217等生物标志提示高风险者，随机接受静脉trontinemab或安慰剂，主要终点为进展至CDR全局分>0的时间。英国Surrey and Borders NHS信托开始欧洲筛查；早期数据称28周内约九成早期患者斑块清除。战略从“治已病”前移到“防未病”，试验或历时数年。

quotes.author: The Guardian / trial framing
quotes.en: People without memory loss will be offered an experimental Alzheimer’s drug that could stop the development of the condition before dementia symptoms emerge.
quotes.zh: 没有记忆减退的人将有机会试用实验性阿尔茨海默病药物，以期在痴呆症状出现前阻止病程。

items.title: Asahi Linux on M3
items.title_zh: Asahi Linux登陆M3：开源把最后一台Mac推向倒计时
items.summary_zh: Asahi在Apple M3上的进展约340赞。粉丝称正因有此类项目，当前Mac会是自己最后一台；务实派指出休眠与HDMI仍是采用路障。逆向开源把“购买锁定”变成可谈判的时间表。

quotes.author: publlus_enigma
quotes.en: The reason this amazing project exists is the same reason my current Mac will be my last Mac. I wish the team every success.
quotes.zh: 这个神奇项目存在的理由，也正是我现在这台Mac会成为最后一台Mac的理由。祝团队成功。

quotes.author: sansah
quotes.en: Lack of sleep and HDMI support is real roadblock for adoption. Hope they gets past soon.
quotes.zh: 缺休眠和HDMI支持是真正的采用障碍。希望他们尽快跨过。

items.title: Europe's NATO planners doubt ability to sustain long war with Russia
items.title_zh: 欧洲北约规划者质疑能否支撑对俄长期战争
items.summary_zh: 多家欧洲防务与政策报道汇总：北约欧洲侧规划人员担心弹药、防空拦截弹与工业扩产节奏跟不上高强度消耗战；美国重心更多转向中东与西半球后，欧洲自主可持续作战能力被重新审视。与“无美军舰机参与的Northern Viking”演习相呼应，暴露的是库存政治而非单次演训口号。

quotes.author: European defence planning discussion (public reporting)
quotes.en: Allied planners increasingly question whether Europe can sustain high-intensity conflict with Russia without a rapid surge in munitions and air-defence stocks.
quotes.zh: 盟军规划者日益质疑：若弹药与防空库存不能迅速跃升，欧洲能否支撑与俄的高强度冲突。

items.fetch_notes: NM列表估分5.7；公开二手报道综合，URL取NM源站提示

items.title: GPT-6 Astra on robot arms
items.title_zh: GPT-6 Astra上机械臂：具身智能演示点燃产品幻想
items.summary_zh: GPT-6 Astra驱动机械臂的演示约231赞。有人呼吁机器人公司先做城市人行道拾荒机器人当早期产品；有人盛赞Astra+Codex的计算机操控体验堪比当年GPT-4与智能体编程拐点。模型名片从聊天框贴到了关节扭矩上。

quotes.author: baron816
quotes.en: Anyone reading this who works/runs a robotics company, I really want to encourage you to build a robot to pick up trash on city sidewalks as an early product. Picking up trash requires a lot of dexterity and will come with many challenges, but I think it’s a simpler problem than many household tasks and it’s probably on par for what these tests show is doable. I think you’re going to have to PR challenges getting people to welcome robots into their homes. If you have robots out in cities providing a public good, not only do they serve as walking advertisements for your company, you’re going to earn some trust before you’re ready deploy them into private spaces. Plus, governments (or perhaps HOAs for wealthy communities) can be good early customers since you can have a focused sales strategy. Politicians love these types of visible quality of life improvement projects. If you can show that your robots, working round the clock, can decrease litter at a low cost, many cities are going to want to buy them.
quotes.zh: 做机器人的朋友，我真心建议把清行人行道垃圾做成早期产品——捡垃圾需要感知、抓取与城市常识。

quotes.author: gizmodo59
quotes.en: If you haven’t tried computer use with Astra with codex I highly highly recommend it. Just like how gpt 4 and agentic coding with cc. This thing is the most exciting stuff I’ve seen in a while. And then all the blender, cad stuff is cherry on top. And it’s fast, they do lots of resets. I feel like they are spending too much money but I’m not complaining. Best 200$ for an AI subscription IMHO
quotes.zh: 若还没试过Astra配合Codex做计算机操控，强烈推荐。就像当年的GPT-4和智能体编程一样，这是我见过最兴奋的东西。

items.title: Trump Venezuela oil deal gives Pentagon ~35% stake via NABEP parent warrants
items.title_zh: 特朗普委内瑞拉石油协议：五角大楼经NABEP母公司认股权拿约35%股份
items.summary_zh: 白宫详述：北美Blue Energy Partners获17个油田约650亿桶探明储量相关权利；国防部战略资本办公室拟以认股权等形式持有母公司约35%股权“零成本”，国务院可按成本采购20%产量并对其余80%享有优先购买权。五角大楼此前曾声明OSC“不持有私人公司股权”，与白宫表述冲突。法理上委内瑞拉是否仍保有矿藏主权、合同期限（25年 vs 百年说辞）争议未消。

quotes.author: White House fact sheet / CNBC
quotes.en: NABEP has in turn granted the Pentagon’s Office of Strategic Capital a 35% equity stake at no cost to the U.S. taxpayer.
quotes.zh: NABEP进而向五角大楼战略资本办公室授予35%股权——据称对美国纳税人零成本。

items.fetch_notes: NM列表估分5.7；据CNBC/CSIS/White House公开材料

items.title: M-DISC – DVD/Blu-ray compatible discs that may last up to 1000 years
items.title_zh: M-DISC：号称可存千年的光盘，驱动与贴牌双重危机
items.summary_zh: M-DISC耐久存储帖约178赞。知情评论称Verbatim已不自制盘、现售M-Disc实为贴牌MABL BD-R；蓝光驱动停产（Pioneer 2024停制）使“千年介质”卡在读头供应链。归档幻想撞上制造业收缩。

quotes.author: mapontosevenths
quotes.en: Verbatim, who owns M-Disc, doesn't even manufacture discs anymore. They just slap their brand on other peoples discs. The discs sold as M-Discs now are actually just MABL BD-R's. They used to have a 'stone' data layer. Now they use a titanium metal data layer. MABL discs were always designed to last for about 100 years, and are orders of magnitude cheaper. 100 years is long enough, and 1000 years was always a wild-ass theoretical abstraction. The point is that you'll be dead before your disc is. If the next generation cares and drives are still available they can copy it to a new source. These same discs are sold with a "Guarantee" as archival discs that are tested with heat/stress to last that 100 years, but any MABL disc really should,and they're much cheaper if you just get regular MABL discs. I think Pioneer is one of the big brands making the archival discs, or at least branding them. I last had to import mine from Japan. If you check the disc ID though, you'll see that archival discs are literally the same disc you can by cheaper without that label. Some M-Discs still have a proprietary disc label, but my understanding is that even those just come off the same lines. Some rea
quotes.zh: 拥有M-Disc的Verbatim甚至已不制造盘片，只是把品牌贴到别人的盘上。现在当M-Disc卖的其实就是MABL BD-R。

quotes.author: noinsight
quotes.en: The drives to read them (Blu-rays) will be the problem. Pioneer stopped manufacturing them in 2024, only LG drives are available now. Coincidentally I just bought one, they’ve doubled in price now recently. Also bought some M-Discs to try. They’re half the price in Japan (Amazon) compared to Germany.
quotes.zh: 读它们的驱动（蓝光）才是问题。Pioneer 2024年停产，现在只剩LG。巧的是我刚买了一台，价格已经翻倍。
